name: Downtown Toronto · City Hall

building_source.name: Toronto 3D massing · 2025
building_source.height_method: Uniform extrusion using source AVG_HEIGHT. No fallback heights, no vertical exaggeration.
building_source.ground_method: Flat reference ground; SURF_ELEV and HEIGHT_MSL are not used as terrain.
building_source.limitation: 2025 illustrative context model, not current surveyed buildings. Heights include LiDAR-derived, site-plan and other source methods. Roof shapes and terrain are not reconstructed. City requires user verification for legal or official use.
building_source.licence: Open Government Licence – Toronto; additional City Planning illustrative-use notice applies.

street_source.name: Centreline - Version 2 - 4326.geojson
street_source.licence_basis: Publisher dataset page explicitly links Open Government Licence – Toronto; API metadata may be unspecified.
street_source.notes:
The Toronto Centreline is a data set of linear features representing streets/roads, walkways, rivers, railways, highways and administrative boundaries within the City of Toronto. Each line segment is described with a series of attributes including a unique identifier, name, feature code, and address ranges (where applicable).
In addition to retaining historical archives, threaded archives are also retained that record splits and merges of address points, of linear features and of area features. All features are linked and integrated.

limitation: 2025 source-height massing on flat ground; not current surveyed buildings or photorealistic reconstruction. Clipped at study edge. Source IDs are snapshot references, not established building identities.
